products.name: Ceramide Ato Soothing Gel
products.category: soothing gel moisturizer for face and body (sensitive & dry skin)

key_ingredients.name: Soy-ceramide™ (Ceramide NP)
key_ingredients.what_it_does: a skin-identical lipid that helps the moisture barrier hold water

key_ingredients.name: Madecassoside
key_ingredients.what_it_does: the calming compound from centella (cica), used to soothe redness

hero_facts: List price ₩17,900 for 175 ml in Korea (about $13); often discounted at Olive Young
US K-beauty shops sell the same tube for about $27 (Mirai Skin $27.01, Sukoshimart $26.85)
Made by Amorepacific; ILLIYOON is its derma body-care brand
Label: dermatologist tested, sensitive-skin panel tested, allergy tested, fragrance free, 10-free
Sister product Ceramide Ato Lotion won Olive Young Awards 2021 #1 body moisturizer; Hwahae Beauty Awards body lotion #1 five years running
The 3rd-generation Ceramide Ato line launched at Olive Young in February 2025
good_for: sensitive skin that gets red or tight
oily or combination skin that wants light hydration
face and body in one product
skip_if: very dry skin that needs a rich cream (reviewers call it light)
you want a treatment product for eczema (it is a cosmetic moisturizer)
products.how_to_use: After cleansing, spread a generous amount over face, arms or legs and pat in; reapply whenever skin feels tight.
products.why_viral: A trusted Korean derma brand (Amorepacific) selling a fragrance-free ceramide gel for a drugstore price; the 'face and body in one tube' idea and the cooling gel texture travel well on short video.
caveats: Ceramide NP concentration is low (label: 104 ppm) – it is a soothing hydrator, not a ceramide treatment
Discount price in Korea changes weekly; list price shown
unverified: Amazon US price ($14 claim on DermFND could not be confirmed)
the gel itself winning an Olive Young award
